cards.text: The believers in Jesus are a whole multitude now, and they are ONE in heart and soul. A whole crowd of people with one heart. Friend, I've seen a group chat of four people that couldn't agree on a meeting time.

cards.question: Nobody among the believers claims their stuff as their own. So what do they do with what they have?

answers.text: They give it all to the priests
They store it all in the temple

cards.text: And the apostles keep giving their testimony with GREAT power. They are not turning the volume down one bit.

cards.question: With great power, the apostles keep testifying about the ___ of the Lord Jesus.

cards.text: And abundant grace is upon them all. Like sprinkles when I open the jar too fast. It gets on EVERYTHING.
Here's how the sharing works. People who own lands or houses sell them and bring in the money. Not junk from the garage, friend, their HOUSES.

cards.question: The believers bring in the money from selling their lands and houses. Where do they put it?
Once the money is laid at the apostles' feet, who is it given to?
With everyone sharing like this, there are no needy ones among the believers.

cards.text: Now meet Joseph, a Levite from Cyprus. The apostles give him a nickname, Barnabas, and friend, wait till you hear what it means.

cards.question: The apostles call Joseph by the name Barnabas. What does Barnabas mean?
Barnabas owns a field. What does he do with it?

answers.text: He sells it and brings the apostles the money
He gives the field to a poor family
He lets the believers farm it together

cards.text: Now a man named Ananias, together with his wife Sapphira, also sells a piece of property. Same move Barnabas made. So far, so good.

cards.question: Ananias and Sapphira have the money from their property. What does Ananias do with it?

answers.text: Keeps back some and brings the rest
Brings every bit of it to the apostles
Gives all of it to his neighbors

cards.question: Sapphira has no idea that Ananias kept some of the money back.

cards.text: So Ananias brings his portion and lays it at the apostles' feet. Then Peter, one of the apostles, speaks up. Uh oh.

cards.question: Peter says Satan has filled Ananias's heart to lie to someone. Who?

cards.text: Peter's not done. He's got questions for Ananias about that land and that money, and friend, they are NOT small talk.

cards.question: Peter tells Ananias that he had to give all of the money from his land.

cards.text: Peter says the land was his before it sold, and the money was his to use after. Then Peter says, "You have not lied to men, but to God!"

cards.question: When Ananias hears Peter's words, what happens to him?

answers.text: He goes to get the rest

cards.question: After Ananias dies, great ___ comes over all who hear what happened.

cards.text: Then the young men step forward. They wrap up his body, carry him out and bury him.
About three hours later, his wife Sapphira comes in.

cards.question: When Sapphira walks in, she knows what happened to her husband.

cards.text: Peter asks her if this is the price she and her husband got for the land. One question. That's all.

cards.question: Peter asks Sapphira if that's the price she and Ananias got for the land. What does she say?

answers.text: No we kept some of it
I would have to ask him

cards.question: Peter asks Sapphira how she could agree to ___ the Spirit of the Lord.

cards.text: Then Peter tells her the feet of the men who buried her husband are at the door. And they will carry her out too.

cards.question: At that instant, Sapphira falls down at Peter's feet and dies. Where do the young men bury her?

cards.text: And great fear comes over the whole church and everyone who hears about these events. Not just the folks in that room this time. The WHOLE church.

findings.problem: Multiple choice dominates stop 1 by a wide margin: 5 of its 7 choice cards are multiple choice, with only 1 fill in the blank (card 4) and 1 true or false (card 9).

rule.text: No formula. Which question type comes next, the order the types come in and where a blank falls are chosen naturally for each card. They never follow a pattern. No stop repeats another stop's pattern, and no type dominates a stop by a wide margin.

findings.problem: The apostles appear here for the first time, but the card never says who they are. Peter later gets "one of the apostles" (stop 2 card 4), but the apostles themselves are never introduced.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: Sapphira's death (Acts 5:10), a key moment, is told only inside the choice card's question. No story card tells it. Card 17 ends with Peter's warning, and her death is never told as Papa Dorin's turn.

rule.text: Story card: Papa Dorin's turn. He tells the next piece of the passage. The setup for a choice is on a story card.

findings.problem: "Not just the folks in that room this time" sets up a contrast the text doesn't show. Acts 5:5 says great fear came over "all who heard what had happened," not just the people in the room, and card 10 itself says "all who hear what happened."

rule.text: Noticing: What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match.
